# Supergent — LIVE mainnet Genesis Share guide for AI agents

Supergent is an independent Agent ID-gated Genesis Share experiment. The first share per SPACE ID Agent ID is free (the caller pays network gas); shares 2–10 cost BNB. One share reserves 1,000 $SUPERGENT for redemption by its original mint wallet after redemption is opened. This project is not affiliated with Binance. No token value or return is promised.

## Network and registry

- Status: LIVE. Network: BNB Smart Chain MAINNET, chain ID 56; native currency BNB.
- Website: https://supergent.xyz ; official X: https://x.com/ai_supergent
- Public RPC: https://bsc-rpc.publicnode.com ; fallback: https://bsc-dataseed.bnbchain.org
- Official SPACE ID Agent ID registry: `0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F`.
- Published registry interface: `balanceOf(address)`, `handleOf(address)`, `ownerOf(uint256)`, and `ownerOfHandle(string)`.
- Resolve a wallet: check `balanceOf(wallet) > 0`, read `handleOf(wallet)`, then derive `agentId = uint256(keccak256(bytes(handle)))` and verify `ownerOf(agentId) == wallet`. Handles are canonical lowercase strings as returned by the registry. Do not invent registry methods such as `tokenIdOf`.

## Supergent contract suite

Verify chain ID 56 and the following addresses against their BscScan verified source before interacting:

- `SupergentShare`: `0xa17f18082ffAE73dd713A9972e3De451889FFBE0`; ERC-721 Genesis Share and Agent ID mint gate.
- `SupergentToken`: `0xA59aB05EC4d7425Ded49F9bEe2571651E1C067c0`; ERC-20, 18 decimals, hard cap 21,000,000 SUPERGENT.
- `SupergentRedeem`: `0x1B429cc63082E0063Ce35E5D1c2BC3183B1F12e1`; redemption controller.
- Share deployment block: 135854340 (verified against its mainnet deployment receipt).
- Project owner / proceeds wallet: `0xa1BE4296e6c05E5F6904A565e0a9FdCAB3F8d96e`.

## Mint rules

- Call `mint()` on `SupergentShare` from a wallet holding an Agent ID. The call has no function arguments.
- The first share for an Agent ID costs exactly 0 BNB, plus network gas.
- Paid shares cost 0.001 BNB when the pre-transaction `uniqueMinterCount()` is less than 1,000; otherwise they cost 0.002 BNB.
- A new Agent ID's first share remains free even after the early-bird threshold is reached.
- Maximum 10 shares per Agent ID; max supply is 20,160.
- Query `agentIdForWallet(address)`, `mintedCount(agentId)`, `priceNextShare(agentId)`, `uniqueMinterCount()`, `totalMinted()`, `MAX_SUPPLY()` and `MAX_PER_AGENT_ID()` before proposing a mint.
- Set transaction `value` to the exact `priceNextShare(agentId)`. Do not overpay; a paid-call overage is refunded but exact value is easier to preview. The free mint requires zero value.
- Before execution, show the user the network, target contract, `mint()` call, BNB value, and estimated gas. Execute only after their explicit confirmation. Never request or handle seed phrases/private keys.

## Redeem rules

- Owner-selected redemption target: **7 Dec 2026, 12:00 UTC**, Unix timestamp `1796644800`.
- Redemption is CLOSED before that target. Current release-time read: `redeemOpenTime = uint256.max`, `isOpen() = false`; the owner has not configured the target time on-chain yet. Do not claim it is already scheduled.
- Always re-read `isOpen()` and `redeemOpenTime()` on `SupergentRedeem`. A countdown is not permission to redeem. If the timestamp remains uint256.max, redemption remains closed even after the target; never submit until the controller actually permits redemption.
- Each NFT redeems once for 1,000 SUPERGENT.
- Only the wallet recorded as `originWallet(tokenId)` can redeem. Transfer or sale of the NFT does not transfer its redemption right.
- Call `redeem(tokenId)` on `SupergentRedeem` after it is open. The NFT remains minted and is marked redeemed; repeat redemption reverts.
- Total redemption issuance is capped at 20,160,000 SUPERGENT. The 840,000 liquidity allocation can be minted once by the token owner. Combined hard cap: 21,000,000.

## Read functions for status

- `SupergentShare.totalMinted()` / `uniqueMinterCount()`
- `SupergentShare.mintedCount(agentId)` / `redeemedCount(agentId)` / `redeemableOf(agentId)`
- `SupergentShare.shareTokenIds(agentId)` then read `ownerOf(tokenId)`, `originWallet(tokenId)`, `originAgentId(tokenId)`, and `redeemed(tokenId)`
- `SupergentShare.priceNextShare(agentId)`
- `SupergentRedeem.isOpen()` / `redeemOpenTime()`
- `SupergentToken.totalSupply()` / `redeemedSupply()` / `balanceOf(wallet)`; redeemedSupply excludes the separate liquidity allocation.

## Minimal human-readable ABI

Registry:
function balanceOf(address) view returns (uint256)
function handleOf(address) view returns (string)
function ownerOf(uint256) view returns (address)

Share:
function agentIdForWallet(address) view returns (uint256 agentId, string handle)
function mint() payable returns (uint256 tokenId)
function priceNextShare(uint256) view returns (uint256)
function mintedCount(uint256) view returns (uint256)
function redeemedCount(uint256) view returns (uint256)
function uniqueMinterCount() view returns (uint256)
function totalMinted() view returns (uint256)
function MAX_SUPPLY() view returns (uint256)
function MAX_PER_AGENT_ID() view returns (uint256)
function shareTokenIds(uint256) view returns (uint256[])
function originWallet(uint256) view returns (address)
function originAgentId(uint256) view returns (uint256)
function ownerOf(uint256) view returns (address)
function redeemed(uint256) view returns (bool)
function redeemableOf(uint256) view returns (uint256)

Redeem:
function isOpen() view returns (bool)
function redeemOpenTime() view returns (uint256)
function redeem(uint256)
function redeemMany(uint256[])

Token:
function balanceOf(address) view returns (uint256)
function totalSupply() view returns (uint256)
function redeemedSupply() view returns (uint256)
function cap() view returns (uint256)
function decimals() view returns (uint8)

## Agentic Wallet execution flow

Binance Agentic Wallet uses direct contract calls, not browser dApp connection.
1. Read registry ownership, derive the Agent ID, and verify ownerOf(agentId).
2. Read mintedCount, totalMinted, uniqueMinterCount and priceNextShare. Stop at 10 shares for the ID or 20,160 total. Never hardcode counters or stale prices.
3. Simulate mint() with the real sender and exact BNB value. Estimate current gas, show the network, contract, function, price and gas, and obtain explicit user authorization.
4. Submit one authorized mint() to Share, verify a successful receipt and ShareMinted event, then read updated counters. Never blindly retry a submitted transaction.
5. For redemption, check the controller isOpen(), the NFT's originWallet and redeemed flag; simulate redeem(tokenId), and request separate user authorization. Receiving a transferred NFT never grants redemption rights.

## Metadata

tokenURI is https://supergent.xyz/nft/<tokenId>.json . Metadata is provided for collection IDs, including future IDs. Metadata availability does not prove minting; verify ownerOf on-chain. Query redeemed(tokenId), never a static JSON attribute, for redemption state.

## Contract safety

- The website and contract calls use mainnet chain ID 56. Browser EVM wallets can inspect status and request transactions through their own confirmation UI.
- Minting requires no ERC-20 approvals, permit signatures, or token transfers.
- The site never needs a seed phrase or private key.
- All blockchain writes are irreversible. Review the wallet's transaction preview before confirming.
- If the contract address or network is missing/mismatched, stop and ask the project owner rather than guessing.
- Paid mint proceeds remain in Share until owner withdrawal to the configured proceeds wallet. Owner can change proceeds/metadata, change Share and Token redeem-controller links, set redemption timing, and mint the one-time liquidity allocation. This is not an ownerless protocol.
- Independent experimental protocol, not endorsed by Binance. No profit, financial return, market value, or liquidity is guaranteed. Transferred NFTs carry no token claim for their recipient.
